svg.text: dmxbox 2 with one output, on two breadboards
Two full-size boards (830 holes, rows 1 to 63), row 1 at the left: board B at the top, board A under it. The five holes of one row on one side of the middle gap are one contact.
Wires: A1 ... on board A, B1 ... on board B, X1 ... from A to B; the list is on the second page. Wire colors only tell the wires apart.
Blue: the isolated side. Its power lines (top) are +5V_ISO and GND2; nothing from board A goes there.
Top lines: +5V (USB) and GND. Bottom lines: +3.3 V and GND.
SW1, turned: switch 1 at the right
SW1, turned: switch 1 at the right
Before the USB cable goes in
• Chips: the notch (and the dot of pin 1) as drawn. U5 stands the other way round from U4.
• U3 (RKK-0505S/H): pins 1 and 2 at the left. U2 (MCP1700): its flat side towards the letters a to e.
• The USB-C breakout: the plan takes its pins as VBUS, D−, D+, CC1, CC2, GND from the left. If yours differ, put each wire on the pin of that name. Without resistors on CC1 and CC2, fit R1 and R2.
